_comment: Configuration for PDF Analyzer. Copy to config.json and customize.
_secrets_note: API keys can be set via environment variable (VT_API_KEY), this file, or password store (pass). See CONFIG.md for setup.

risk_thresholds._note: Risk score thresholds: 0-low=likely safe, low-medium=suspicious, medium-high=probable malicious, above critical=confirmed malicious. Tune against your own PDF traffic.
